selection_scope: Repeatedly used developmental selection; head-level fitting CV conditional on a fitting-supervised frozen observer

protocol.MRI: region centering from nonempty training visits, mean imputation; patient-balanced deterministic SVD, no whitening, one common score RMS
protocol.calibration: four global sigmas from outer-excluded teacher-forced location predictions; no location refit after attachment
protocol.validation_scope: head-level cross-fitting conditional on an observer supervised on fitting observations; selection repeatedly developmental
